definition: One complete side-neutral recording per listed supported teaching meaning. Exact SAN, squares, scores, names and historical counts remain written. This is a finite summary plan, not verbatim coverage of every possible bubble or a claim that 71 is the only possible product design.

selectionPolicy.unit: First successfully rendered claim in the current main bubble; not merely first input claim or highest raw priority.
selectionPolicy.sameVoice: The selected Older teacher identity is now saved. Eight short examples from this bank are recorded in walter-contrasts-plan.json; the remaining scripts are still planning only and production TTS quality awaits owner listening.
selectionPolicy.scope: Game review and variations only under current speech-pilot policy. Full-app narration is a separate scope, described in surfaces.
selectionPolicy.sourceProof: Static source reachability with focused renderer checks, not a population coverage percentage or end-to-end speech validation.
selectionPolicy.variantPolicy: One recording per written script. Alternate wording and delivery takes are optional editorial work, not implied by template permutations.
selectionPolicy.secondary: 21 scripts cover supported subordinate meanings; do not record or auto-play them under the primary-only policy without an explicit scope decision.

common: Use current visible Walter main-bubble utterance, matching coach/intent/position/evidence generation; known mover except explicit automatic board outcome.

Retain exact selected claim identity or a validated projection in the renderer. Trace code alone is ambiguous for repeated same-code claims; sourceIds may legitimately be empty for book, human, reply and terminal claims.

Validate original required slots and evidence even when details remain only in writing. Resolve positional/tactical event by exact source identity; do not infer scope or actors from prose, grades or expressions.

Require no current-position error or unresolved position request. Do not use PositionCoach input.pending directly: it includes !!actor and is true for ordinary reviewed moves. Background refinement alone should not mute a ready baseline.
autoSpeakSuitable is necessary policy metadata, not permission by itself. It can be true for unsupported freeform/legacy paths and hidden human popover utterances.
Reject stale results and cancel speech on navigation, coach changes, hide/unmount or mute. No backlog, hidden-popover speech, or replay caused by background updates.
Never fall through to a lower supported claim solely because the primary has no clip. Unknown/malformed/unmapped input stays silent.
positional: All required claim slots must remain valid despite being omitted from the recording.
facts.side must be exactly white or black. If claim has side slot, it must agree. Validate event.actor against actual mover. No side inference from learner orientation.
position.line must agree with facts.line (actual -> actual; best -> alternative) and the selected actual/best move identity. Never infer actual scope from missing position metadata.
gates.humanModel: Only learner moves; human available/evidence_id nonempty; practical exists and matching human_evidence_id; human.mover matches mover; played and engine_best UCI match report; difficulty neither unknown nor forced. All model wording remains estimates rather than population truth; same script covers limited confidence.
gates.recordedGameRelationships: Actual game only, no branch; matching current node ply and intelligence.input_digest; learner move and node.actor=orientation; relationship last ply=current and actor=orientation. History supported only, related current ply. Backend needs valid searches/contiguous compatible nodes for sequence relationships; repeated scope observed reviewed plies.
gates.terminal: Terminal checkmate clips require the current board termination/result, independently of animation expression. A recorded PGN result alone does not establish checkmate.

surfaces.coverage: 71 primary-capable scripts; 21 further meanings only if a future policy includes secondary displayed claims.
Reuse applicable recordings; no original-game relationship/history or clock fabrication. No separate variation sentence required.
Seven existing human meanings: four reuse primary scripts, three are in the secondary set. An explicit narration action could use these; hidden render must not speak.
Dynamic board cues and annotated continuations require a separate structured spoken projection. No additional arbitrary-detail clips counted.
Cold, retry/error, accepted/recovered and dynamic explanation feedback. Explicitly excluded from current speech policy; no answer hints before existing authorization gate.
Curated-answer messages bypass game dialogue. Do not infer objective Best or reuse game truth from expression. Separate practice work.

Authored lesson text, feedback and historical-game annotations bypass semantic renderer. Course narration is a separate finite-content recording inventory per course revision, not included in game pack.
Explicit puzzle-state messages bypass game dialogue; no installed production collections currently. Generic practice cues are separate from this evidence-summary pack.
Study setup/instruction copy, not analyzed move coaching; no game recordings.
Audition/testing only, never an independent production narration trigger.

reachabilityNotes: There are 11 general motif IDs across role restrictions: nine all-role motifs, hanging_piece allowed-only, missed_tactical_capture played/missed-only. Add three mover causes.

No separate recording is required for absolute pin subtypes, discovered check vs discovered capture, ordinary promotion vs underpromotion, or double check vs other two-piece attack when script stays at verified umbrella meaning.

Game review's pin emitters are absolute-pin rules. Relative-pin findings and trapped_piece are emitted by separate classification defensive probes, not game_review.line_evidence. They are outside current game speech.

Back_rank allowed/missed are emitted claim combinations, but coherent engine mate scores also produce priority100 allowed_mate/missed_mate. Thus those two tactic recordings are not selected under primary-only policy. Keep as explicit deferred rows, not required launch files. No frontend static guard prohibits synthetic inconsistent reports from displaying these; this is a production consistency deduction.
Generic played/missed capture motif names must use human-readable undefended capture, never literally missed tactical capture for played.
Recognition may identify a tactical shape without positive settled material delta; do not promise material gain, forced collection, or that all defenses fail.

The tactical claim's current detail field can be fork targets, settled material gain, first witnessed capture, or empty. These do not require additional scripts when the complete record says only the verified motif. More outcome-specific recordings are optional refinements.
gameIntent.ts:70 admits best-line positional claims only on poor reports; actual priority66 and alternative priority61 are assigned in eventClaims.ts:17.
Fresh generated poor reports come from cp loss>=50, allows_mate, mate_lost, or opportunity_missed (game_review.py:54-80). opportunity_missed itself requires objective poor (game_review.py:166-211).
For cp losses, gameIntent.ts:117-120 adds loss priority82 unless another claim already has priority>=78. Either way a positional claim cannot be primary.

For allows_mate/mate_lost, event_facts.py:24-39 emits a mate event, converted to priority100 in gameIntent.ts:55. The analysis IDs needed to emit it are the same IDs required for positional events (events.py:128-139).

Therefore every alternative positional script is deferred for current primary-only speech. It is a real displayed semantic branch and may appear as secondary text; it needs a recording only if selection policy changes. Actual positional meanings can be primary on nonpoor reports absent higher-ranked claims.
Source audit only; no new runtime scenario sweep or provider generation was performed.

Count 35 is unique complete scripts: book/book_sound share one; recovery help empty/nonempty requires two; mate win/loss intentionally keep different pedagogical responses, not merely duplicate delivery takes.

Seven secondary-only files are optional under present main-bubble-primary policy, not required today. HumanInsight separately renders a human claim as primary in its existing popover; would need explicit new playback trigger. The recognized-opening file also covers secondary-only book at no extra file cost.

Do not multiply clock by low/critical or model estimates by confidence/difficulty: common scripts retain exactly the current presented teaching point while quantities and qualifying provenance remain visible. Avoid using provider brand because human provider can differ.
Repeated/history share relationship-specific scripts across motifs. Current bubble retains exact motif/count; spoken purpose is recurrence, not re-teaching a tactic.
Critical-resource purpose is decisive_resource for best cp>150, so safer script says advantage, not proven/decisive win. Search scope remains explicit.

Backend events check, finish, evaluation_change and human_contrast are not directly mapped to extra claim codes by gameIntent. Outcome uses frame automatic_outcome; loss uses score comparison; human uses guarded practical facts.
No rating-only scripts, no assumption about frequency, no cross-product of labels/personas/sides, no paid/provider calls.

The two back-rank secondary exclusions rely on coherent searched mate scores and principal variations. The frontend alone can render synthetic inconsistent reports; such reports are not extra production recording needs.
There is no empirical frequency analysis or claim that the bank covers a measured percentage of games. Counts represent reviewed semantic paths, not all combinations of dynamic fields.

Dropping side ownership from positional summaries is deliberate, not permission to swap actors. The validated written explanation supplies identity; audio does not say you or assert a strategic benefit.
